correctness.rationale: For every fixed support labeling, interior gaps admit exactly the transition counts of required parity, while a nonempty exterior edge budget fills all integer totals from the minimum disagreement count through an explicit maximum. Alternating queried labels force k>=s-1; the opposite-to-gap-parity choice forces k<=n-s. Both endpoints queried force an incompatible endpoint xor parity across labelings. This proves the iff criterion for all n>=2 and 0<=k<n. Direct matroid truncation gives all polynomial coefficients. An explicit independent-threshold subfamily and the distinct-hypothesis leaf count prove the online bounds. The independently encoded exhaustive checker tests 40,960 support instances for n<=11, all transition counts, plus exact online dimensions for n<=9; no finite experiment is substituted for the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: A full infinite two-parameter classification of all shattered coordinate supports for a natural exact-complexity regular-language family is mathematically motivated. It establishes an explicit matroid structure, all cardinality coefficients and maximum supports, with a sharp parity boundary at the two endpoints; the fixed-parameter online separation complements this structural result. Unlike a routine VC-rank bound or a finite numerical table, the classification gives the entire support complex uniformly in n and k.
